question.text: Any PMS distributor must obtain registration with:

answer.text: APMI (Association of Portfolio Managers in India)

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI circular (May 2, 2024) mandates APMI registration for PMS distributors. The Trap: AMFI handles MF distributors; other SROs are unrelated. Cross-Exam Context: Same APMI registration in X-B, XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Registering with APMI triggers code of conduct and MF-like discipline for PMS distributors.
